verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI documents a models page with more than one model option: a Universal-2 fallback for languages outside the primary model's set, a Medical Mode domain add-on, and a streaming mode with a published ~150ms p50 latency. The pack does not show a side-by-side comparison of models with accuracy or cost numbers, and community commenters noted the absence of WER benchmarks. Those threads are old, but they confirm the gap rather than contradict a claim. Missing for 10: published per-model accuracy/WER figures, per-model cost/pricing tradeoffs, latency figures across all models, and independent corroboration of the tradeoffs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: the system automatically falls back to Universal-2, giving you coverage across 99 languages total without any extra configuration.
Medical Mode (domain: "medical-v1") is an add-on that enhances transcription accuracy for medical terminology
Handles live audio over WebSocket with ~150ms p50 latency
